description: Ex 42-93685, later VH-GAK. Flew about 47,500 hours before retirement to a children's park in South Australia in 1971, then trucked to Midland for a McDonald's restaurant and used for children's parties 1987-2000 painted in fictitious markings as VH-MMF Fortescue of MacRobertson Miller Airlines. Later at former RAAF Caversham, painted in Trans-Australia Airlines colours as a film prop, and trucked to the Myalup mine site on 23 August 2003.
aliases: DC3; DC-3C; DC3C; VH-GAK; VH-MMF; c/n 13624
